% Adapted from the TeX Live pgfplotstable dec sep align documentation.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplotstable}
\begin{document}
\pgfplotstabletypeset[
  columns={sample,value},
  columns/sample/.style={column name=Sample,string type},
  columns/value/.style={column name=Measured,fixed,fixed zerofill,precision=2,dec sep align}
]{
sample value
A 1.2
B 12.34
C 123.4
}
\end{document}
